NetIntDen = bgMean*Area - IntDen per band, normalizes to a reference lane,
and can also compute the loading volume per lane needed to equalize the
reference (actin) band.

density quantification, WB densitometry, relative protein expression from a
blot, loading-control normalization, or asks "measure the bands", "灰度值",
"条带定量", "内参归一化", "上样量怎么调", with a blot image attached.

Triggers: Western blot quantification, WB densitometry, band intensity,
grayscale measurement, ImageJ Measure equivalent, loading control
normalization, actin normalization, co-IP blot quantification,
gel band optical density, 条带灰度, 灰度值测定, 内参归一化, 上样量归一化.

Self-verifiable: `scripts/make_test_image.py --verify` builds a synthetic
blot with known ratios and checks the pipeline recovers them.
